records.text: Anonymous tipsters reported that Erika Kirk was with Tracy Martin when Mikey and Elizabeth McCoy called and that Erika was not with her mother.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep DYD_QHMPwqM)

appearances.snippet: this is a pretty strong series of tips that I received that Erika (Erika Kirk). ... was with a woman named Tracy Martin. ... she was with Erika (Erika Kirk) when Mikey (Mikey McCoy) and Elizabeth (Elizabeth McCoy) called. ... In fact, I'm being told that her and her mother were not together.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. The claim is based on anonymous tipsters whose identities, firsthand knowledge, and records are unavailable. Searches found no independent evidence establishing that Erika Kirk was with Tracy Martin during the McCoy call rather than with her mother.
